Tutorial restarts at its entrance. Adventure gear and checkpoints stay separate.
1 Move & observe: reach the gold marker on the left with WASD, then aim toward the upper-left range.
2 Fire & cover: hit both gold targets in the upper-left. Walk around the wall to hit the covered target.
3 Dodge warnings: meet a slow bullet in the centre lane and dodge through it with Space. Retry safely if hit.
4 Gear: collect a coin below, take the shotgun with E and hit its target above. Fire until energy runs short, then press 1 for the pistol.
5 Items: take the medkit below with E and heal with Q. Then choose one of the two passive stations to the right and inspect the change.
6 Map & objective: open and close Tab map. Activate the upper-right beacon with E, then press E at the right-hand gate.
7 Final drill: defeat two guards and a low-damage elite on the right. After clearing them, press E at the exit.

DPS uses the last 10 seconds of effective game time, or time since reset when shorter. Pauses do not age samples.
The armored target reduces damage by 50%. Statistics use effective damage and reset on gear changes.
Upper-left range: static target on the left, moving target in the middle, armored target on the right. Close this panel to fire.

Upper-right lane: slow bullets, a warned charge strip, and ground hazards. Gold warns; orange deals damage.
